summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals plc filed a Form 8-K reporting that its wholly owned Luxembourg subsidiary Jazz Financing Lux S.à r.l. entered into Amendment No. 4 to its May 5, 2021 Credit Agreement on September 23, 2026. The amendment reprices and extends the U.S. dollar term loan B-2 facility, converting existing B-2 loans into new Tranche B-3 dollar term loans and borrowing an additional $273.31 million to repay non-converting lenders. Maturity moves to May 5, 2033 from May 5, 2028. This is a routine credit-facility repricing, not a special situation; watch spread and covenant terms.
